projectDescription: An open-source, local-first, AI-native Markdown note-taking app for Mac and iPhone with daily notes, wiki links, backlinks, local search, and optional BYOK AI — all backed by plain Markdown files you own.
keyFeatures: Daily notes as the default capture surface — the app opens to today's note
Wiki links (`[[…]]`) and automatic backlinks for association-first organization
Local full-text search (⌘K) and optional on-device semantic search
BYOK AI (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, OpenRouter) with `private: true` hard-block
Audio memos with async BYOK transcription and auto-formatting
Chrome browser capture via local native-messaging host (no cloud relay)
iCloud Drive sync with on-device conflict resolution
GitHub / generic SSH git remote backup with versioned history
`reflect` CLI for scripting and agent workflows (read-only, JSON output)
`reflect://` deep-link scheme for navigation and capture from external apps
Plain Markdown files as the source of truth — no proprietary database lock-in
Tauri 2 desktop shell (not Electron) with a React/TypeScript frontend
publicApiSurface: reflect:// URL scheme — navigation: reflect://today, reflect://daily/YYYY-MM-DD, reflect://note/<target>, reflect://search?q=…, reflect://tasks
reflect:// URL scheme — write: reflect://append?text=…, reflect://checkbox?text=…, reflect://task?text=…
Graph folder layout: daily/YYYY-MM-DD.md, notes/<slug>.md, assets/, audio-memos/, .reflect/
Frontmatter fields: id (ULID), title, aliases, private
AI provider config: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, OpenRouter (BYOK, stored in OS keychain)
